title: agent: commit the Message/changes position only after the caller has stored what poll returned
description: From A5 (mimid-1wgh.13.12). Agent::poll saves state.json (the server's Message state, consumed MLS keys) before AgentChat::sync writes the plaintext store, so a crash between the two loses the messages that poll decrypted: they cannot be decrypted again. Fix: poll returns events plus a token; the caller calls Agent::commit(token) after it has stored them. MLS key consumption is the hard part: OpenMLS deletes the secret tree entries in process_message, so a re-decrypt after a crash needs the plaintext kept first (e.g. the agent writes received plaintext to its own journal in the same transaction). Documented in mimid-agent-jmap persist.rs Limitations.
close_reason: Journal in state.json; receive/acknowledge; sync acknowledges after its store write. The window between the OpenMLS sqlite write and the journal save remains, documented in journal.rs.
